'''R-3DO''' was a [[protocol droid]]<ref name="DF" /> working at the [[Resistance base]] on [[D'Qar]].<ref name="Episode VII" /> The [[Color|red-colored]] [[droid]] monitored the Resistance's [[Resistance spy droid network|network]] of [[spy droid]]s.<ref name="DF" /> R-3DO was present at an assembly of Resistance members watching the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' take off with [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] at the controls, leaving to find [[Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="Episode VII" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
R-3DO first appeared as an unnamed background character in ''[[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens]]''.<ref name="Episode VII" /> The character was first named when released as an action figure in [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] Parks' [[Star Wars: Droid Factory (toy line)|''Droid Factory'']] toy line, as an exclusive to Star Wars [[Celebration Orlando]] in [[2017]].<ref name="DF" />
